items.title: Joseph Daley interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, March 18, 2018
items.q: he passed it on to people like Bob Stewart, Dave Bargeron, Earl McIntyre

ctx.x: How did that work with — the working with the bassist?

Oh yeah that’s the whole thing. In that band it was a bass player, his name was Herb Bushler. And him and Howard were like very good friends. And what Howard would do is he would listen to what Herb was playing on the bass, and he would pull out certain parts of what Herb was playing and incorporate those into the tuba part. So Howard was not only playing tuba parts, sectional parts, he was also playing tuba bass parts in conjunction with the bass player. And then at certain points he would say okay well rather…
Well Howard Johnson was like your graduate school.
